title.value: Dynamic Price of Parking Service based on Deep Learning
title.justification: The title is extracted directly from the paper as given.
title.quote: Dynamic Price of Parking Service based on Deep Learning

extractions.description: The paper proposes a dynamic pricing system for regulated parking services based on air quality predictions using deep learning. The goal is to discourage parking of motor vehicles when poor air quality episodes are predicted to improve urban air quality in Madrid, Spain. Several deep learning models, including CNN and LSTM, are evaluated for their effectiveness in predicting air quality alerts and adjusting parking prices accordingly.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is utilizing deep learning to propose adaptive parking pricing to mitigate air pollution in urban areas. This directly relates to environmental sustainability and public health.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The improvement of air-quality in urban areas is one of the main concerns of public government bodies... In this work, a proposal for dynamic prices in regulated parking services is presented.

primary_category.justification: The focus of the paper is on air pollution reduction by using a pricing mechanism for parking services based on predicted air quality levels. This aligns with pollution reduction efforts, specifically targeting air pollution.
primary_category.quote: Air pollution is one of the most critical health issues in urban areas with a tough concern for governments and citizens.

secondary_categories.justification: By utilizing technology to reduce reliance on personal vehicles, this paper indirectly supports climate change mitigation efforts through decreased emissions from vehicles.
secondary_categories.quote: For monitoring and mitigating the adverse effect of air pollution, governments have proposed... the promotion of public transport, the creation of Low Emission Zones.

primary_sub_category.quote: The improvement of air-quality in urban areas is one of the main concerns... This proposal aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) of the United Nations.

applications.value: Dynamic pricing for public parking based on air quality predictions
applications.justification: The main application explored is dynamically adjusting parking prices to influence vehicle usage based on air quality predictions, aiming to reduce air pollution.
applications.quote: In this work, a proposal for dynamic prices in regulated parking services is presented. The dynamic prices in parking service must discourage motor vehicles parking when low-quality episodes are predicted.
